record.title_md: Hamiltonian cycles in powers of infinite graphs
record.subject: Infinite Graphs

dossier_meta.catalog_title: Hamiltonian cycles in powers of infinite graphs
dossier_meta.subject: Graph Theory » Infinite Graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: Conjecture \item If $ G $ is a countable connected graph then its third power is hamiltonian. \item If $ G $ is a 2-connected countable graph then its square is hamiltonian.
dossier_meta.context_text: (Reproduced from [M].) Both results are known to be true for finite graphs (the second part is the celebrated result of Fleischner) and also for locally finite graphs [G].
